instruction: How to import a snippet in Caddyfile
output: echo '(headers) { header { X-Content-Type-Options nosniff X-Frame-Options DENY } } example.com { import headers reverse_proxy localhost:8080 }' > /etc/caddy/Caddyfile

How to add request matcher by query parameter
output: echo 'example.com { @debug query debug=1 handle @debug { respond 200 Debug } }' > /etc/caddy/Caddyfile

instruction: How to run Caddy as a file server
How to set up Caddy to serve multiple sites from one Caddyfile
output: echo 'site1.example.com { root * /var/www/site1 file_server } site2.example.com { root * /var/www/site2 file_server }' > /etc/caddy/Caddyfile

instruction: How to add rate limiting in Caddyfile
output: echo 'example.com { rate_limit { zone dynamic { key {remote_host} events 10 window 1m } } reverse_proxy localhost:8080 }' >> /etc/caddy/Caddyfile

instruction: How to add path-based routing in Caddyfile
output: echo 'example.com { handle_path /api/* { reverse_proxy localhost:8080 } handle { root * /var/www/html file_server } }' > /etc/caddy/Caddyfile
